svg.title: Lemonade Lake layout
svg.text: LEMONADE LAKE · Lemonade Lake · 96x60 tiles · road 5 tiles wide
Lap 230 tiles = 29,401 px · about 35 s per lap · closest the road comes to itself: 10.8 tiles
Dark channel = deep water (full speed). Pale water = shallows (slower). Patches = banks (slowest; hovercraft skim them).
Buoys mark the tight bends. White chevrons = current. Brown wedge = jump ramp. Orange = fizz/boost. Shore = wall.
Gold dashes = Fizzy Falls: 35 tiles, 3.5 wide, instead of 41 tiles of main channel
Gold dashes = Straw Slide: 34 tiles, 3.5 wide, instead of 31 tiles of main channel
